test_title: SSC Selection Post Matric Level Official Paper (Held on: 3 Feb 2022 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: In September 2021, which of the following states announced that it would set up an electronic park?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Uttar Pradesh.**__

__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] Key Points__**

__
 
• The **Yamuna Expressway Industrial Development Authority (YEIDA)** area is where the Uttar Pradesh government plans to build an** electronic park **to produce **electronic accessories.**
 
• The electronic park is anticipated to bring in an **investment of Rs 50,000 crore **to the area, according to **YEIDA CEO Dr. Arun Veer Singh**, and it would **employ thousands of local youths.**

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] Additional Information__**

 
• The Park is most likely to be built on a** 250 acre plot** of land in YEIDA's** Sectors 14 or 10,** close to Jewar Airport.
 
• The **1942 industrialists **will be investing** Rs 17,272.74 crore** to set up their factories which will employ** 2.65 lakh people.**
 
• The regional establishment of a** toy park, film city, medical device park, and leather park** has also been announced by the state government.
 
• Over** 20,000 people** would be employed by the **Medical Device Park**, which will be built on** 350 acres of land** in Sector-28 for a cost of** Rs 5,250 crore.**
 
• More than **15,000 people** will be employed by the **Film City project.**
 
• Similarly,** Toy Park and Leather Park** will provide employment to over** 10,000 youths** each.
